meta.commitMessage:
Cancel stale breakout reviews unless existing higher-direction priority supports them

Reuse the unchanged initial breakout predicate at discovery and confirmation. All previous risk/target gates still run first. Existing stronger direction may support minor reactions; cancel rather than add waiting when both original trigger and higher priority are absent. Public native incident13 inputs and checksum are archived; original quote/stop/TP1 reproduce and this development case is rejected under the consistency guard. 343 LBank tests pass. Not independent profitability validation or replacement-strategy promotion. Tested tree cbf343b437ba1379dc2304f706db30b0f8746814.
